items.title: Tom Baker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: I’m doing a festival with Dan Barrett and some Dutchmen next March.

ctx.x: I think Benny Waters is 94, and I think he’s tops.
94. Right. I’m doing a festival with Dan Barrett and some Dutchmen next March. That’s the next time I’ll be in the States. The Arbors Jazz Party.
Yes. We’re thinking of going there.
